notes.title: 🎉 Vampirates Release Date Revealed! 🧛‍☠️
notes.notes:
That’s right, the moment has arrived! We’re thrilled to officially announce the release date for Vampirates!


🦦, drumroll please...

🥁🎶🥁🎶🥁🎶


Vampirates rises from the dead on July 4th at 2PM CEST!


A huge thank you to everyone who shared feedback, played our demo, and supported us along the way, we couldn’t have done it without you! 💜

[strike]Well... technically we could’ve made the game without you… but let’s be honest, it wouldn’t have been nearly as awesome.[/strike]



Mark your calendars! We’ll see you on July 4th to hurl zombies (and Kevin) together!
